name: ANTI
text: Unmodified wound roll of Y+ vs keyword X = critical wound

name: ASSAULT
text: Unit can use assault shooting (shoot after advancing)

name: BLAST
text: +1 (or +X) attack dice for every 5 models in the target unit (round down)

name: CLEAVE
text: If ALL of that weapon's attacks target one unit: +X attack dice for every 5 models in the target unit (round down)

name: CLOSE-QUARTERS
text: See A1

name: PISTOL
text: See A1

name: DEADLY DEMISE
text: When the model is destroyed, roll D6: on a 6, every unit within 6" suffers X mortal wounds

name: DEVASTATING WOUNDS
text: Critical wound: no save, target suffers mortal wounds equal to D. These mortal wounds can only damage ONE model per critical wound (excess lost). Resolved after normal damage

name: EXTRA ATTACKS
text: Used in addition to the model's other melee weapon

name: FEEL NO PAIN
text: See A2

name: HAZARDOUS
text: See A2

name: HEAVY
text: Your Shooting phase: +1 to hit if unit is unengaged, was not set up this turn, and no model moved more than 3"

name: IGNORES COVER
text: Target can't get the benefit of cover (incl. Stealth)

name: INDIRECT FIRE
text: Can use indirect shooting

name: LANCE
text: +1 to wound if the attacker charged this turn

name: LETHAL HITS
text: Critical hit can auto-wound

name: MELTA
text: Target within half range: +X to D

name: ONE SHOT
text: Usable once per battle

name: PRECISION
text: Attacker can allocate to a visible CHARACTER group

name: PSYCHIC
text: Can ignore any modifiers to BS/WS and to the hit roll

name: RAPID FIRE
text: Target within half range: +X attack dice

name: STEALTH
text: Every model in the unit has it: the unit has the benefit of cover vs ranged attacks

name: SUSTAINED HITS
text: Critical hit = X extra hits

name: TORRENT
text: Auto-hits

name: TWIN-LINKED
text: Can re-roll the wound roll

name: DAMAGED
text: While the model has X or fewer wounds left: its attacks have -1 to hit
